engine: The NAHIRNA dialect of the day↔night canon (window.DayNight): the pinned scroll-scrub hero. Day dissolves to night across ~110% of viewport-height of scroll; a warm window-glow rises and a legibility scrim deepens, all riding the SAME normalized progress t the canon writes from a ScrollTrigger. This is NOT a new engine — it is mode:'scrub' + reveal:'opacity' on the canon, plus the Nahirna caption layering (kicker pill, masked-line headline, sub, scroll hint) and a one-time intro reveal. Harvested 1:1 from apps/nahirna/components/sections/00-Hero.tsx.

drives_canon.why: the seed crossfades two frame-matched STILLS (day → night) via opacity on scrub. The living-video pair was removed in the real build because the two clips were different shots and the house jumped — STILLS keep the house pinned in place. opacity-only reveal = no clip-path on the scrubbed surface.

measured_seed.scrolltrigger: { trigger: root, start:'top top', end:'+=110%', scrub:true, pin:true, pinSpacing:true, anticipatePin:1 }
scrub_timeline: tl.to('.hero-hint', {opacity:0, ease:'none', duration:0.1}, 0)            → variation hint fade
measured_seed.intro_once: gsap.timeline({defaults:{ease:'expo.out'}}): kicker(from y16,1.2s,delay .2) → lines(from yPercent110,1.6s,stagger .12) → sub(from y18,1.4s) → hint(from opacity,1.0s). NOT tied to scrub.

scrub.start.what: where the pin engages and the dissolve begins.

scrub.end.what: scroll distance of the full day→night dissolve (~110% of viewport height — the Nahirna value).

scrub.pin.what: pin the hero while the dissolve plays (pinSpacing true, anticipatePin 1 via the canon).

glow.what: warm window-glow that rises with t. true = the real Nahirna radial gradient; or pass a css-gradient string.

scrim.what: legibility scrim peak opacity (the seed deepens the bottom band so the caption stays readable as night arrives).

kicker.what: address pill: place + warm edge line. Plain string also accepted.

headline.what: array of lines; each line slides up once out of an overflow:hidden mask. Last line tinted warm.

sub.what: the sub line under the headline.

hint.what: scroll hint; fades out as the scrub begins (driven from onUpdate).

entry: DayNightScrub.create(target, opts) -> { dn, root, set(t), get(), replay(), destroy }. `dn` is the underlying canon api. set(t) is the canon's PURE passthrough. replay() re-runs the one-time text intro only (never the scrub). REQUIRES window.DayNight (load ../daynight-engine/component.js first) AND GSAP + ScrollTrigger.
law: opacity / gradient only on the scrubbed surface (night.opacity, glow.opacity, scrim.opacity); GPU compositable; NO canvas drawImage (Nahirna rejected it for iOS), NO mix-blend, NO backdrop-filter, NO WebGL. Night still EAGER-loaded (lazy = mid-scrub decode stutter). prefers-reduced-motion -> static: night hidden, glow/scrim off, text instantly visible, no scrub (canon disarms armScrub under reduced-motion; the variation skips the intro and the autoplay nudge).
proven: lab.html: a TALL 250vh scroll container pins the exterior-house hero; scrolling drives day→night across +=110%, the warm glow rises and the scrim deepens off the single canon t, the caption stays legible, and the intro reveals once (expo.out, staggered masked lines). Uses the exterior pair renders/dn-ext-day.webp + renders/dn-ext-night.webp.
